metadata.title: Quad-Panel Soul Portrait Layout
useCases: Vintage soul or jazz album covers

retrievalProfile.description: A four-panel grid of portraits framed by a thick mustard-yellow border with heavy, top-aligned sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: mustard yellow frame with blue grid lines

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical 2x2 grid of four distinct studio portraits of the same subject, separated by thin blue lines and encased in a wide, flat mustard-yellow border. The top section features two lines of heavy, light-blue sans-serif text justified to the left, accompanied by a series of small pink heart icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical 2x2 grid within a thick outer frame
High-contrast color pairing of mustard yellow and light blue
Repetition of subject across four distinct poses
coreInvariants: Heavy sans-serif display type at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four medium close-up portraits occupying equal quadrants of the central square.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-left quadrant and the bold header text above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from the top-left text, moving across the top row, then down to the bottom row.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Thick mustard yellow border acting as a structural frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation border contrasting with high-key, bright studio photography.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophe is a simple vertical or slightly slanted rectangle

composition.relationshipToImage: placed above the grid within the border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales for main title and bottom metadata.
graphicDevices: Rectangular metadata block at bottom center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century grotesque feel.
Provides the necessary vertical weight and density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four studio portraits of the same woman in different poses against a white background. Enclose the grid in a thick mustard yellow border with thin blue lines separating the quadrants.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy, light-blue uppercase sans-serif text in the top left corner of the yellow border. Place a row of six small pink hearts to the right of the first line.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly four portrait panels?
Is the text light blue and extra bold?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the yellow background.
Verify the four portraits are distinct poses.
Check that the blue grid lines are perfectly centered.
Confirm the hearts are uniform in size and color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a 2x2 grid of portraits + wrap in a thick mustard border + add heavy blue sans-serif headers + separate with blue lines.
